training-warrior-militia: At fifteen, {firstName} joined the city militia. Years of night watches and tavern brawls taught {{him|her|them}} never to leave a comrade behind.
training-warrior-arena: {firstName} learned to fight in the arenas of the south, where the crowd decides who lives, and won {{his|her|their}} freedom with a broken sword.
training-warrior-knight: An old knight took {firstName} into service and taught {{him|her|them}} that a shield is raised for others before oneself.
training-warrior-mercenary: {firstName} sold {{his|her|their}} sword to the Free Companies, crossed a dozen wars, and learned that loyalty is the rarest currency of all.
training-mage-academy: {firstName} studied at the Arcanum of Civitas, spending more nights in the library than in bed, and left with a master's ring and far too many questions.
training-mage-hedge: No academy would take {firstName}, so {{he|she|they}} learned magic from an old hedge-witch who paid in riddles and burned more soup than spells.
training-mage-wild: Magic awoke in {firstName} during a storm and set a barn on fire. Learning to master it took years of patience, and a few more barns.
training-mage-grimoire: {firstName} found a forbidden grimoire in a ruined chapel and taught {{himself|herself|themself}} from its whispering pages.
training-rogue-guild: The Shadow Guild took {firstName} in and taught {{him|her|them}} locks, rooftops, and the art of vanishing into a crowd.
training-rogue-street: On the streets, {firstName} survived on quick hands and quicker wits, until a queen of pickpockets saw talent where others saw trouble.
training-rogue-scout: {firstName} served with the scouts of a border fort, learning to move without a sound and to read the forest like an open book.
training-rogue-spy: A noble house trained {firstName} in espionage, teaching {{him|her|them}} to smile, to listen, and to forget nothing.
training-cleric-temple: {firstName} was raised in the temple of the Dawnfather, where prayers began before sunrise and healing was learned at the bedside of the poor.
training-cleric-vision: A fever brought a vision that changed everything: {firstName} woke with a god's voice in {{his|her|their}} heart and the power to heal in {{his|her|their}} hands.
training-cleric-battle: {firstName} followed the armies as a battle priest, a mace in one hand and bandages in the other.
training-cleric-pilgrim: {firstName} walked the long pilgrimage to the Seven Shrines and came back with calloused feet and an unshakable faith.
training-ranger-border: For years, {firstName} patrolled the wild borders with the Grey Wardens, tracking raiders through snow and mud and sleeping under the stars.
training-ranger-hunter: An old hunter taught {firstName} to read tracks, move without a sound and loose an arrow between two heartbeats.
training-ranger-wolf: Lost in the forest as a child, {firstName} was followed for weeks by a grey wolf. By the time the village found {{him|her|them}}, the two were inseparable.
training-ranger-guide: {firstName} earned a living guiding merchants through the Thornwood, learning every path, every danger and every shortcut the maps forget.
training-paladin-order: {firstName} swore the oath of the Order of the Dawn at sixteen, then spent years learning that a shield protects better than a sword.
training-paladin-vision: A vision of light came to {firstName} on a battlefield, among the dying. Since that day, {{he has|she has|they have}} carried an oath nobody else heard.
training-paladin-squire: {firstName} served as squire to an old knight who had lost everything but his honour, and learned from him that an oath counts most when it costs something.
training-paladin-redemption: After a crime {firstName} never speaks of, {{he|she|they}} knelt before a temple and swore to spend a lifetime making amends.
training-bard-college: {firstName} studied at the College of Whispers, where students learn ballads, lies and the exact moment to stop talking.
training-bard-tavern: {firstName} learned music in smoky taverns, playing for a meal and a roof, until a song about a corrupt baron made {{him|her|them}} famous and wanted.
training-bard-troupe: Raised in a troupe of travelling players, {firstName} knew a hundred roles before knowing {{his|her|their}} own.
training-bard-lorekeeper: An old lorekeeper made {firstName} memorise the songs of forgotten kingdoms, because some stories are the only thing left of a people.
training-druid-circle: {firstName} was taken in by the Circle of the Old Oak, where the druids taught {{him|her|them}} to listen to the rain, the roots and the seasons.
training-druid-hermit: {firstName} spent seven years alone in the marshes with a hermit who spoke more often to herons than to people.
training-druid-blight: When a blight killed the forest of {{his|her|their}} childhood, {firstName} swore to learn the old magic that makes things grow again.
training-druid-shapes: {firstName} discovered {{his|her|their}} gift the night {{he|she|they}} woke up as a fox. Learning to come back took a whole winter.
training-barbarian-tribe: {firstName} grew strong among the clans of the frozen north, where children wrestle bears for sport and storms are greeted with songs.
training-barbarian-pit: Sold to fighting pits as a child, {firstName} survived on rage alone, until the day {{he|she|they}} broke {{his|her|their}} chains on a guard's helmet.
training-barbarian-spirit: During a trial in the mountains, {firstName} met the spirit of a great bear, and has fought with its fury ever since.
training-barbarian-raider: {firstName} sailed with the raiders of the Iron Coast, learning that the axe solves many problems and creates a few more.
training-warrior-company: {firstName} signed up with the Iron Lanterns, a mercenary company, and learned that a good shield-mate is worth more than a good sword.
training-warrior-veteran: An old one-armed veteran took {firstName} as a pupil, teaching every trick of the sword with the arm that was left.
training-mage-apprentice: {firstName} served as apprentice to an eccentric wizard who lived in a crooked tower and paid in lessons, broken teapots and occasional explosions.
training-mage-library: Hired to dust the shelves of a great library, {firstName} read every forbidden book there at night, and learned magic one stolen page at a time.
training-rogue-smuggler: {firstName} grew up running crates for smugglers along the coast, learning every hidden cove and how to lie to customs officers with a smile.
training-rogue-cardsharp: {firstName} learned the trade in gambling dens, dealing cards from the bottom of the deck and reading every bluff before it was made.
training-cleric-battlefield: {firstName} served as a chaplain on the battlefields, praying over the dying of both sides and learning that the gods do not wear colours.
training-cleric-orphanage: {firstName} grew up in a temple orphanage and stayed to care for the next children, discovering a quiet faith in soup, stories and bandages.
training-ranger-messenger: {firstName} carried royal messages across the wild lands, alone for weeks, learning to outrun storms, wolves and bandits.
training-ranger-monsters: {firstName} apprenticed with a monster hunter who knew the weakness of every beast and the price of every mistake.
training-paladin-tournament: {firstName} won fame in the tournaments, until the day a defeated rival was left to die and the glory suddenly felt hollow; the oath came soon after.
training-paladin-temple-guard: {firstName} stood guard for years at the gates of the Temple of the Dawn, and learned that patience and vigilance are also forms of courage.
training-bard-herald: {firstName} served as herald to a duke, announcing guests, wars and weddings, and learned that how a thing is said matters as much as what is said.
training-bard-busker: {firstName} learned to sing on street corners for coins, and to read a crowd faster than any priest or general.
training-druid-storm: {firstName} spent a winter alone on a storm-beaten cliff, until the wind itself began to answer.
training-druid-garden: {firstName} learned the old ways tending the royal gardens, where a forgotten circle of druids still meets among the roses.
training-barbarian-desert: {firstName} grew up among the sand clans of the red desert, where water is sacred and fury is the only shelter from the sun.
training-barbarian-avalanche: When an avalanche buried {{his|her|their}} whole village, {firstName} dug out of the snow with bare hands, and something wild has burned inside ever since.
